decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk line builds on established office competence and serves a growing workplace trend, so its uncertain upside justifies the low carrying cost of keeping the option.
A chair family close to the core offer is cheap to keep in the catalogue and its value is still unresolved after only one year.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory line, but they share materials with the rug collection, so carrying costs are low while demand is still uncertain.
The sofa is only mentioned rather than featured, which signals weaker support, but upholstery fits the core business and keeping it costs little.
A high standing table fits the conference and lounge offer and adds configurable variety at minimal incremental cost.
The rug collection is the flagship of the firm's new direction, and as a distant, highly uncertain move it carries high option value that management will preserve while results unfold.
